---
description: Catches a turn that is about to end without a reply.
agents: [author]
fact: reply.owed > 0
at: run-end
repeat: once per turn
---
This turn is about to end, and the player has no reply: nothing you wrote this turn was marked as the reply, and only a marked reply reaches the chat. Prose you wrote unmarked went nowhere. Write the reply now, in your answer to this, marked the way the reply contract says. Reading or recording more does not write it.
